errorEmpty: Enter a hub address or paste a pairing link.
errorAddress: That isn't a hub address. Use something like hub.example.com:18662, or paste a pairing link.
errorMachineLink: This link pairs a computer's Persona Link, not an app. Create a link for a new device in Settings › Devices instead.
errorPinNoPort: This pairing link has a key fingerprint but no TLS port. Create a new one on the hub.
errorNoToken: This pairing link has no token. Copy the whole link again.
connectSubtitle: Sign in to your hub to see your agents, the assistant and the Inbox.
offlineBody: Check that the hub machine is on and online, and that this computer can reach it.
addHint: On a device that's already signed in, open Settings › Devices › Connect a new device and copy the app's pairing link: it signs this app in and pins the hub's key. A browser sign-in link works too; with a plain address, also enter a sign-in token.
settingOpenAtLogin: Open Persona when you log in
pinnedHint: Only the public key from the pairing link is accepted for this hub.
agentsEmptyHint: Agents you start on your computers show up here.
agentsPick: Choose an agent to see its chat
cardElsewhere: This kind of request can be answered in the web app or on your phone.
cardOther: The agent is waiting for you
cardReadOnly: This agent can't be answered from here.
composerReadOnly: Messages can't be sent from here
errorNeedToken: Enter a sign-in token, or paste the pairing link instead.
errorRefused: The hub refused this sign-in. Pairing links work once and for 10 minutes: create a new one.
errorUnreachable: Can't reach the hub. Check the address and that this computer can reach the hub machine.
inboxClearHint: New messages and mail that need you show up here.
inboxNoneDone: Nothing handled in the last 3 days
inboxPick: Choose an entry to read it
machinesEmptyHint: Connect a computer with Persona Link to run agents on it.
machinesSubtitle: Your computers connected to this hub
personaNone: The assistant isn't set up yet
personaNoneHint: Set it up on the hub in the web app or the phone app, then come back here.
settingNotificationsHint: When an agent needs you or finishes, and for the assistant's alerts.
signedOut: The hub signed this app out. Sign in again.
todosEmptyHint: Add one above, or ask Persona to note something down.
todoNotesPlaceholder: Details, links, what done looks like
todoNoAgents: No agent has worked on this yet.
todoDeleteBody: The agents that worked on it stay.
startNoComputers: None of your computers is online. Start Persona Link on one, then try again.
startPromptPlaceholder: What should the agent do? Leave empty to start it idle.
kbPickHint: What Persona knows from your chats, mail, meetings and agents, kept on the hub machine.
kbTaggingHint: What you set here stays; automatic tagging won't change it.
kbAskText: How is "{name}" going? Tell me the latest progress, what's waiting on me and what to do next, and handle what you can for me first.
terminalType: Type into the terminal, Enter to send
terminalReadOnly: This agent's terminal can only be watched.
changesNoneHint: Everything in this folder is committed.
changesBinary: A binary file: no diff to show
changesTruncated: The diff is too long; the rest isn't shown.
personaNewHint: A chat of its own, beside the main one
attachTooMany: A message takes at most {count} pictures
palettePlaceholder: Go to an agent, a chat, a to-do or a page
devicesFooter: Phones, watches, browsers and computers signed in to this hub. Revoking one signs it out at once.
pairHint: Scan this with the Persona app on your phone, or copy the link and paste it into the app on another computer.
extensionsFooter: What the hub can do beyond its own: connectors, channels, voice and more. Settings and installing new ones are in the web app.
connectorsFooter: Where the Inbox and the knowledge base read from. Signing in is in the web app or the phone app.
modelsFooter: The model each thing the hub does uses. A use left on Default follows its category or the hub's default.
changesUpstreamGone: Its upstream branch was deleted on the remote
startPresetHint: Tiers of the model profile {profile}: a launcher with its model and effort
agentEndBody: The agent quits and its tab closes. Its chat stays in the list.
agentRemoveBody: It leaves every list. The transcript stays on the computer.
overviewNoComputersHint: Agents run on your computers. Add one to get started.
overviewStuckHint: These agents are waiting on you, but nothing here can answer them. Open the chat or the terminal.
routinesBadEvery: Enter a number of minutes, 1 or more.
routinesBadTime: Enter a time like 09:00 (and a date like 2026-01-31 for once).
routinesHint: What Persona does on its own, on a schedule
gitRefusedOldNode: Persona on that computer is too old for this: update it
gitRefusedGitDetached: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch first
gitRefusedGitNothingStaged: Nothing is staged: check the files to commit
gitRefusedGitHookFailed: The commit was refused (a hook, usually pre-commit)
gitRefusedGitIdentity: Git on that computer has no name and email to commit with
gitRefusedGitNoUpstream: This branch has no upstream yet
gitRefusedGitNoRemote: No remote named origin to push to
gitRefusedGitPushRejected: The remote has newer commits: pull first, then push
gitRefusedGitAuth: The remote refused the credentials on that computer
gitRefusedGitConflict: Uncommitted changes would be overwritten: commit or stash these first
gitRefusedGitBusy: Another Git command is running there (the agent's?): try again in a moment
gitRefusedGitNoBranch: No such branch, or that name can't be used
gitRefusedGitNoStash: Nothing to stash, or that stash is gone
gitRefusedNoGh: GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed on that computer
gitRefusedNotSignedIn: GitHub CLI (gh) is not signed in on that computer: run gh auth login there
gitRefusedGitNotPushed: Push the branch first: a pull request needs every commit on GitHub
gitRefusedGitNoPr: This branch has no pull request
gitRefusedGitNotGithub: This repository has no GitHub remote
gitRefusedGitStashStale: The stash list changed. Refresh and select the stash again.
gitRefusedGitStashUnsupported: Safe stash removal is unavailable for this repository.
filesPick: Choose a file to see it
filesTruncated: Only the first entries are shown
gitAutoMergeOn: It will merge once its checks pass
gitNoPR: No pull request for this branch
gitPickCommit: Choose a commit to see it
gitPushFresh: {branch} goes to origin for the first time and tracks it.
modesBusy: The model changes once it's idle
profileNoMachine: No computer to run on yet
profileReachAgents: Your agents: start them, answer them, follow them
profileReachHint: Persona works through the hub, with what you connected.
profileReachInbox: The Inbox, mail and connected chats
profileReachPhone: Reminders and calendars on your phone
readyChatOnly: Chat only: Persona answers but can't start agents yet.
ultracodeHint: Several agents work on it at once, using a lot of quota
kbFactsEditHint: Add facts you want Persona to keep. To clear them, remove all text and save.
kbFactsHint: Your corrections are preserved when Persona updates this entry.
kbFactsRefreshFailed: Your confirmed facts were saved, but the latest entry could not be loaded. Retry refreshing: {error}
kbFactsSaveFailed: Could not save your confirmed facts. Your draft is kept. Retry saving: {error}
kbRelAcceptedReadError: The hub accepted the request, but verification failed: {error}. Retry verification to check both entries without sending another removal.
kbRelKeep: Both entries are kept, including their content and confirmed facts.
kbRelLock: “{name}”: protect the entire {list} list from automatic changes.
kbRelLockHint: This affects every relationship in these two lists. Automatic updates will no longer add or remove other relationships in them.
kbRelPartial: The removal request failed: {error}. The latest entries do not confirm complete removal and protection. Some changes may have been saved. Retry removal to finish the same correction.
kbRelRejectedReadError: The removal request failed: {writeError}. Some changes may have been saved. Verification also failed: {error}. Retry verification before trying removal again.
kbRelSuccess: Relationship removed and protection confirmed on both entries.
kbRelUnconfirmed: The hub answered, but both entries do not confirm removal and protection. This hub may need an update. Retry verification or close and check the hub version before trying again.
mailBadAddresses: These don't look like email addresses: {addresses}
mailReplyAllHint: Reply to the sender and everyone in To and Cc
mailReplyAllUnavailable: Reply all needs the receiving account address to load
mailNewNoAccount: New email (add a mail account in the web app's Settings › Connectors first)
setPersonaAboutNote: This is added to the end of Persona's instructions. Changes apply to new chats.
setPersonaAboutNoteHub: It's using the manager's config for now; once you save here, this takes over.
setPersonaAboutPlaceholder: For example: where your code lives, skills you use, machines or folders to leave alone, how you like updates
setPersonaAboutSaved: About me saved. Applies to new chats
setPersonaIndexHint: MEMORY.md: the table of contents Persona keeps, updated when a memory is deleted. Read-only
setPersonaKnowsFooter: About me is what you tell Persona. Memory is what it noted on its own in chats. You can edit both.
setPersonaMemoryEmpty: No memory yet. Persona keeps your preferences and the things you've corrected here.
setPersonaNotificationsFooter: When on, tasks sent from the main chat don't get their own notifications, Dynamic Island, or badge. Persona tells you in the main chat when they finish, need an answer, or fail. Only affects tasks sent from now on.
setPersonaPermissionsHint: Applies only to new non-guest sessions without an explicit permission choice. Existing sessions keep their mode. Runtime policy may be limited by the platform.
setPersonaPermissionsUnconfirmed: The assistant did not confirm this permission setting. Reload before trying again.
setPersonaProactiveFooter: Starts work on schedule, follows up on what it promised, and notifies your phone when done. Say "brief me every day at 9" or "remind me in an hour" in a chat to add one here.
setPersonaQuietTasks: Notify main chat tasks in the main chat only
setPersonaRunsOnFooter: Each chat runs in the background in this directory on {machine}, outside herdr. Transcripts and memory stay on that machine; About me, scheduled tasks, and settings live on the hub. Pick the model under Model settings › Main chat.
setPersonaRunsOnNone: No computer chosen to run on yet. Once a computer is connected, conversations run in the background on it.
setPersonaStartFooter: When on, what you ask Persona to do in the chat starts at once and the plan card only shows progress; tasks Persona comes up with itself still wait for Start. Read-only tasks and kinds you chose to start without asking always start at once.
setPersonaStartRequested: Start what I asked for in the chat right away
setProfilesFooter: Profiles apply on the next call or Agent start. Ask Persona to switch profiles or edit their Agent presets; edit the rest through the hub API.
setProfilesNoTiers: No Agent presets in this profile. Ask Persona to add one.
setProfilesNoneActive: No profile is in use, so Agent presets are off until you apply one.
setSkillsEmpty: No skills yet. Put each skill in its own folder (with a SKILL.md) under ~/.persona/skills/ on the computer running the assistant.
setSkillsFooter: Stored in ~/.persona/skills/ on the computer running the assistant, one folder each (with a SKILL.md). Updating personad leaves them alone. Changes take effect from the next new chat.
setSkillsFooterMachine: Stored in ~/.persona/skills/ on {machine}, one folder each (with a SKILL.md). Updating personad leaves them alone. Changes take effect from the next new chat.
setTriageAutoContinueHint: Sends "continue" after a temporary model error (503 and the like), up to 3 times
setTriageDecideHint: When an agent waits for your call, its question and options go to Needs you
setTriageEnabledHint: Shows what each agent is waiting for; finished ones no longer count as Unread
setTriageFooter: Each time an agent stops, the hub reads its last reply with the triage model (once per turn, using the model you chose in {model}). Auto-continue and scheduled wake-ups run another turn on the agent's own model. The hub only asks you about things like pushing code, deploying or messaging other people; it never does them itself.
setTriageReplyReminder: Remind me when I haven't replied
setTriageReplyReminderHint: If an agent asked you something and you still haven't replied {minutes} minutes after seeing it, you get one reminder. Rule-based, no tokens used
setTriageToolLoopHint: Ask whether to interrupt when an agent appears stuck repeating tool calls
setTriageUnsupported: This hub doesn't support session triage yet. Update the hub, then come back here.
setTriageWakeHint: Agents waiting on a deploy, CI or another agent get woken up to check for themselves
agentArchiveBusy: Busy now: archive it once it's done
agentArchiveCloseBusy: Busy now: it can't be closed while it works, waits, loops or runs a server
archivedDescription: Archiving keeps each conversation on its computer. Restore one to return it to Agents; new activity brings it back too.
archivedEmptyBody: Archive an agent from its ⋯ menu to keep it out of the Agents list.
archivedUnsupportedBody: Update the hub and its managers to archive agents.
archiveErrBusy: This agent is busy: it is working, waiting for an answer or has background work. Archive it once it is done.
archiveErrCloseBusy: This agent is busy (working, waiting, a loop, queued messages or a server), so it can't be closed now. Archive it without closing, or wait until it is done.
archiveErrUpgrade: Update the hub's manager to archive agents.
archiveErrCloseUpgrade: Update the hub's manager to archive and close agents.
archiveDoneNotRunning: Archived “{title}”. It wasn't running, so there was nothing to close
archiveDoneStillOpen: Archived “{title}”, but it's still open on its computer: {reason}
archiveDoneUnknown: Archived “{title}”. The hub didn't say whether it closed
archiveCloseDetail: Persona archives “{title}” and closes its tab and process on {machine}. The transcript stays on the computer: restore it from Archived agents, and a message resumes it.
usageUnreachable: The gateway can't be reached; these are its last numbers
usageError: The gateway couldn't read this account just now; these are the numbers it had stored
hubUpUnsupported: This hub is too old to check and update its version here. Update it once with install.sh on the hub machine, and it will work.
hubUpAutoNotice: The hub updates itself when idle.
hubUpUpdateFooter: The update waits until the assistant and all agents are idle before restarting the hub. If the new version won't start, it rolls back on its own. Connections drop briefly during the restart.
hubUpAutoFooter: When on, a new version installs itself once the assistant and all agents are idle, then sends a notification.
hubUpConfirmBody: This won't wait for them to finish: anything waiting on the hub is interrupted (the assistant's current turn, file uploads, terminal connections). Agents in herdr aren't affected and reconnect once the hub is back.
hubUpNodesFooter: After an update, the hub moves personad on your computers to the same version. For any that didn't update, open it and choose Redeploy.
hubStStateWaitingBusy: Waiting for {count} busy tasks to finish
hubStStateWaitingIdle: Waiting for the assistant and agents to be idle
hubStWarningBad: This version failed to start last time and was rolled back. Auto-update won't install it again.
hubStWarningHeld: Auto-update won't install this version: {why}. If it looks fine, update manually.
hubStDockerSetImage: On the hub machine, set PERSONA_IMAGE in the .env next to the compose file to:
hubStDockerRun: On the hub machine, run in the compose file's folder:
hubStDockerHow: A Docker hub updates with a new image. When there is one, run this in the compose file's folder:
mgrHint: Each manager is a whole assistant, running wherever you choose.
mgrUnsupported: This hub's version doesn't support managers yet. Update the hub and come back.
mgrDeleteBuiltin: The manager the hub runs itself can't be deleted
mgrDeleteDefault: The default manager can't be deleted. Make another one the default first
mgrDeleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Its token stops working right away and its connections are closed.
mgrNewHint: You get an install code. Install it on the computer that will run it within 10 minutes.
mgrCommandsNote: Run one of these on the computer that will run it. Once installed, it shows up in the list. The code works once.
mgrCodeNote: Install the manager with this code on the computer that will run it. Once installed, it shows up in the list.
sentIntro: What Persona sent in your name through your connectors, newest first. Select a row for the full text.
sentEmptyRecorded: Recorded: what Persona sends in your name through a connector (mail, GitHub comments, Lark writes), and sends an extension reports itself.
sentEmptyNotRecorded: Not recorded: what you send yourself in the app, writes that were refused, declined or failed, and anything lark-cli writes.
sentNoDatabase: This hub runs without a database, so what was sent as you isn't recorded.
sentForbidden: Only a device with full access can read this list. Open Persona on one of your own devices that has it.
sentUnsupported: This hub's version doesn't record what was sent as you yet. Update the hub and come back.
sentByCard: Confirmed by you on a card
chanIntro: Talk to Persona from anywhere. Messages go to the main chat (or the chat you pick), replies go back where they came from, and agent questions and approvals are sent there too. Once you answer somewhere else, they stop waiting.
chanDisableFooter: When off, it stops receiving messages. Binding and settings are kept.
chanTestFooter: Only sent to you, the bound account.
chanUnbindBody: Messages to the bot in {name} will no longer reach Persona, and pending replies and questions won't be sent there. To use it again, bind it again.
chanQrFooter: Scan with {name} on your phone. This continues once you confirm.
chanBindFooter: Once bound, only your messages to the bot go to Persona.
chanWaitingPair: Waiting for you to send it to the bot in {name}…
chanStSectionMarketFooter: Extensions from the market that add channels. Bind them here once installed.
mailAccMailFooter: Accounts live on the hub. Passwords are stored encrypted and never sent back. The Inbox, assistant, and AI twin share them. You can also just tell Persona "add my email account."
mailAccGmailNotConfiguredTitle: This hub isn't set up for Google sign-in
mailAccGmailNotConfiguredBody: Once an admin adds google.client_id to the manager's manager.json and restarts the hub, the phone app can sign in with Google (a one-time setup). Until then, add Gmail with an app password.
mailAccGmailAppPasswordHint: Turn on 2-Step Verification for the Google account, then create a 16-character password under Google Account › Security › App passwords and enter it here (not your Google password).
mailAccLarkHint: Lark Mail: the servers are always imap.larkoffice.com:993 and smtp.larkoffice.com:465 (SSL), so just enter your address and password. Use the third-party client password from Lark Mail settings.
mailAccImapHint: QQ, 163, iCloud, and others fill in the servers from the domain. Chinese providers usually need an app password (授权码) rather than your sign-in password. For Outlook, pick Outlook above.
mailLibMailEmailInvalid: That email address doesn't look right
mailLibMailPasswordEmpty: Enter a password or app password
mailLibMailPortInvalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535
mailPhoneOnly: Gmail and Outlook sign in with Google or Microsoft: add them from the Persona app on your phone. Once added, they show up here and in the Inbox.
shortcutsIntro: The desktop app's keyboard shortcuts. The global shortcut that shows or hides the window is set under General.
shortcutsWindow: Show or hide Persona from any app
shortcutsPages: Go to a page (Persona, Overview, Agents, To-dos, Inbox, Scheduled, Knowledge, Computers)
provManagedEmpty: None yet. Choose Add provider, pick one and paste its key. Pick what uses it under Models.
wizNameHint: Letters, digits, _ and -. You pick it by this name in model configuration.
wizUrlGatewayHint: Base URL of an Anthropic Messages-compatible gateway, without /v1.
wizAuthBearerHint: Authorization: Bearer (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN). Most gateways use this.
wizAuthKeyHint: x-api-key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). The official Anthropic API uses this.
wizKeyHint: Stored encrypted on the hub and never returned by the API.
wizTestCost: Testing sends one very short request, which may cost a little.
wizCustomDetail: A relay, a company gateway or another Anthropic Messages compatible service. You enter the address and how it signs in.
wizDiscoverFailed: Couldn't fetch the model list: {error}. You can add models by hand in the next step.
wizDiscoverFound: Found {count} models. Check them in the next step.
mktMarketIntro: Extensions from the marketplaces this hub has added. See what each one can do before you agree to install it. Packages are checked against the marketplace's sha256.
mktMarketEmpty: This marketplace has no extensions yet
mktCanFooter: These are listed again before installing, and nothing is installed until you agree. If a later version asks for more, you'll be asked again before it updates.
mktNoPermissions: It's just a manifest. It runs no program and needs no permissions.
mktMorePermissions: The new version asks for more permissions than you agreed to before. Check what's new before deciding. If you don't agree, it won't update and the current version keeps working.
mktUnresolved: Can't install yet: {items}. Resolve these and preview again.
mktPreviewExpired: This preview has expired. Close it and select Install again.
mktUninstallBody: Stops its program and deletes its package, config, and secrets, along with the connectors and other things it provides. To use it again, reinstall it from the marketplace.
extReadOnly: This extension is set in its manager's manager.json. Turn it on or off and change its settings there or in the admin page, then restart the manager.
extSecretsFooter: Secrets are stored encrypted on the hub and given only to this extension. Once saved they're never shown again; you can only replace or clear them.
extPermissionsFooter: You agreed to these when installing. If a new version asks for more, you'll be asked again before upgrading.
extSecretReplacePlaceholder: Enter a new value to replace
extNotANumber: A field isn't a number. Fix it to save.
provAssign: Use it for the main conversation and new Agents
healthEmptyBody: Ask a question above to start the first one.
healthHeroBody: Sleep, steps, heart rate, weight and diet, answered from the health data on your phone. Chats and memory here are kept apart from Persona's other chats.
healthMemoryEmpty: Nothing yet. Goals, allergies, medication and the like remembered in health chats show up here.
healthPrivacyDoctor: This gives explanations and suggestions; it doesn't replace a doctor's diagnosis or treatment.
healthPrivacyMemory: Health memory is kept on its own and never flows into other chats; you can view and delete it any time.
healthPrivacySeparate: Health chats stay here: Persona's other chats can't see or read them.
healthPrivacyWhere: Chats and memory stay on the hub's machine and don't go into the knowledge base.
healthReportDeleteBody: The original and its summary will be deleted for good. Anything your health conversations and health memory already mention stays; remove that separately.
healthReportNoRecord: This report has no summary yet. Open the original to see the report itself.
healthReportPrompt: This is my checkup report. Please go through it item by item: {paths}
healthReportsEmpty: None yet. Reports you upload stay here, and you can view or delete them anytime.
healthSourcePhoneBody: Steps, sleep, heart rate, weight and more, read through your phone. The Persona app needs to be open on it.
healthSourceUploadBody: Choose Upload a checkup report and pick a PDF or a photo: each item is read out and the ones outside the reference range are marked. The original and its record stay in Health, so years can be compared.
healthSourceWriteBody: Say “log my weight” or “I drank 300 ml of water”; it's saved to Health after you confirm on the phone.
healthSuggestionHeart: Has my resting heart rate changed lately?
healthSuggestionSleep: How did I sleep this week?
healthSuggestionSteps: How do my last 7 days of steps compare to the week before?
msgEmptyNoMatchHint: Search covers loaded chats only. Scroll down to load more.
msgEmptyNoneHint: Your Lark direct and group chats will show up here.
msgNoLarkHint: Once the hub has an extension that provides Lark, all your direct and group chats will be listed here.
msgNoLarkTitle: The hub isn't connected to Lark messages
msgOlderFailed: Earlier messages didn't load. Click to retry
msgPickHint: Click a direct or group chat in the list to open it here.
wbAgentsHere: Agents on this machine in this folder
wbBindDirectoryHint: This only adds the folder; no agent starts. The hub checks and normalizes the path.
wbDeleteColumnBody: Deleting a column doesn't delete any workspace or agent. Its cards (archived ones too) must move to another column first.
wbDirectoryPlaceholder: Enter the absolute path of a real folder, or pick one below
wbDiscoveryKept: Existing cards stay in their columns and can still be viewed.
wbLibConflictReloaded: The board was updated elsewhere and has been reloaded. Try again.
wbLibConflictReloading: The board was updated elsewhere. Reloading…
wbLibReadOnly: This connection can only view the board. Use a connection with full access to edit it.
wbLibUnsupported: This hub version doesn't support the workflow board yet, or board storage isn't enabled. Update the hub.
wbNoAgentsDetail: No agents in this workspace. You can start a new one; the card stays on the board.
wbNoneDiscovered: No workspaces found. You can choose a real folder on an online machine.
wbReadonly: Read-only connection · You can view workspaces; editing needs full access.
wbSetOffBody: Turn it on in Settings › General › Agents. Columns and cards you set up before are still there and come back as they were.
wbSetSettingHint: Lays out your agents as a board by code folder, with its own entry in the sidebar. Off by default. Saved on the hub, so every browser matches. Turning it off only hides it; the board's contents stay.
wbSetSettingReadonly: A read-only device can't change this.
wbSubtitle: Move tasks along by workspace · Sorted by hand
wbUnavailable: The board isn't available right now.
terminalTypeHint: Click the screen and type; keys go straight to the terminal
termsPickHint: Pick a terminal on the left to watch and type into it.
termsUnsupportedBody: Update the hub and your computers to browse every terminal pane here.
previewCrashed: The page crashed. Reload to bring it back.
previewExternal: The page wanted to open {url}, which isn't on this computer
previewNoBrowser: That computer has no Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave to draw the page with.
previewNoServersHint: When an agent starts a server it shows up here. To start one from here, add it to .claude/launch.json in the project:
previewPortGone: Nothing listens on that port any more
previewProblemEnv: its env isn't a list of names and values
previewProblemLocal: its url is on another computer
previewProblemRun: it has no command and no url
previewStartBody: This runs in a new terminal tab of the agent's workspace. Stop it there with Ctrl-C.
previewStartTimeout: {name} didn't start listening within 90 seconds. Its terminal tab shows why.
